message.text: Good morning, Boss! My Care aaj bhi aapke saath hai — padhai, araam aur phone ki health, teeno ka khayal rakhenge. Din shubh ho!
message.title: Welcome Boss! 👋

message.text: Apps khol-bund, khol-bund — kuch samajh nahi aa raha kya karein? Kuch accha karte hain:
message.title: Bore ho rahe ho, Boss?

message.text: Aap lagatar {minutes} minutes se phone chala rahe hain. Aankhon ko 2 minute ka break dijiye — padhai bhi fresh dimaag se hoti hai.
message.title: Thoda araam kijiye, Boss

message.text: Aap {minutes} minutes se {app} chala rahe hain. Aap padh rahe ho... nahi... to fail ho jaoge! Agar yeh padhai nahi hai to thoda break le lijiye.

message.text: Good morning! Aaj ki padhai shuru karte hain. Ek chhota sa target rakhiye, phone ko side me rakhiye — My Care nazar rakhega.

message.text: Kal subah ke liye alarm chahiye? 'Alarm banao' dabakar title likh dijiye — time na likha to subah 6:00 ka alarm lagega. Alag time chahiye to title ke saath 7:30 jaisa time bhi likh sakte hain.
message.title: Alarm laga dun, Boss? ⏰
